maria.partnerships: Quick sync — we're finalizing the joint perf/W numbers for the press release. Who's available?
aj.hw: Yes, latest runs finished on NovaEdge 2.0 — avg 2.7 perf/W at seq=512. Uploading artifacts to S3: s3://redwood-bench/partner-novaedge/180999
maria.partnerships: @aj.hw can you confirm which kernel flags we pinned?
aj.hw: Pinned: --tensor-fuse=on --kv-cache=packed --quant=8bit. Exact cmd:
```
./run_bench.sh --model redwood-v3 --seq 512 --flags "--tensor-fuse --kv-packed --quant=8"
```
tom.product: Marketing needs embargoed summary + figures by EOD Tue. Do we have delta vs baseline (Ampere V4)?
aj.hw: Delta vs AmpV4: +12% throughput, -9% power. CSV uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/partner-novaedge/deltas.csv
cheryl.mktg: Need high-res graphs + a short blurb. Who owns the methodology note?
maria.partnerships: Methodology owners: @aj.hw for kernel details, @tom.product for datasets & workloads. Add line: "standardized load: redis-based throughput harness".
benchbot: Test run 1809998899 completed: all checks passed — artifacts sha256: abcdef1234567890
cheryl.mktg: Legal requested partner quote approval. @NovaEdge_POC is contact. Can someone ping them?
tom.product: Drafted partner quote, DM'ing NovaEdge_POC and pushing embargo doc: https://docs.google.com/drive/xxx (restricted)
aj.hw: One ask: saw 2% regression at seq=1024 on a specific kernel. Will add footnote and patch reference PR-4711.
maria.partnerships: Checklist for launch day: 1) Final CSV + graphs in S3, 2) Partner quote approved, 3) Marketplace listing copy + screenshots, 4) Press contacts list. I'll add a short table in the shared doc.
cheryl.mktg: :thumbsup: If all items done by Mon EOD, we can schedule marketplace banner for Wed.
